calculation.description: Ranks instruments by the negative completed-session open-to-close return; positive values identify assets that sold off intraday and may mean-revert on the next close-to-close session. Uses only the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Positive and stable across 2020-2022 (IC 0.05431, ICIR 0.16121), 2023-2024 (0.05529, 0.16579), and 2025-2026 (0.04832, 0.14035). Cross-section is the 15 tradable benchmark instruments; dates have at least 8 valid names.
